description: This file contains integration tests for the Loan accrual transaction behavior on charge submitted dates within the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup methods, multiple test cases verifying accrual transactions, their posting, adjustments, and interactions with business dates, disbursements, repayments, and loan rescheduling. It uses JUnit5, RestAssured, and Fineract-specific helper classes.

classes.name: LoanAccrualTransactionOnChargeSubmittedDateTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying accrual transaction logic related to charges submitted date in the Apache Fineract project. It contains multiple test cases covering accrual posting, adjustments, job executions, and interactions with loan lifecycle events.

methods.description: Initializes test setup before each test, configuring request/response specs and helper instances.

methods.description: Test case for loan cob processing adding periodic accrual entries during business step for charge submitted date.
